title: DIR-092: Candidate Hero and Metric Cards Executive Enhancement
spec:
Developer must enhance the Candidate Welcome Hero (src/components/Candidate/CopilotHeroHud.jsx) and the 4-card metric row (src/components/Candidate/CubaMetricCardRow.jsx) to achieve 100% executive polish:
1. Fix greeting name truncation: Remove premature truncation (truncate) from the h1 heading and adjust the layout so that 'Good morning, <FirstName>! 👋' is completely visible without clipping across desktop and laptop viewports (e.g. at 1280px-1440px with sidebar and executive rail open).
2. Relieve layout crowding: Relieve crowding between the greeting, the quote ('Better resumes. Brighter opportunities.'), and the action buttons (+ Create Resume, Explore Jobs, Mock Interview). On viewports where space is tight, ensure the quote wraps or gives precedence to the greeting without squishing action buttons.
3. Elevate the Avg. ATS Score metric card: Display a bold, prominent score number (e.g. '32%') alongside the SVG donut ring, creating consistent typographic weight with the other three metric cards (5, 2, Ready).
4. Apply authentic Cuba executive glassmorphism polish: Refine card backgrounds, border lines, subtle shadows, and hover transitions using approved Cuba tokens.
5. Invariants: Keep src/cv-templates/ untouched (diff = 0), use real platform data, preserve all test IDs (cuba-copilot-hud, cuba-welcome-greeting, cuba-copilot-insight, cuba-copilot-cta-*, cuba-metric-cards, cuba-metric-*), preserve accessibility labels, and ensure all existing regression tests pass.
invariants: Zero modifications to src/cv-templates/ (diff must remain exactly 0).
Zero hardcoded mock data or fabricated metrics; all values bind to real platform reads.
Cuba design token compliance (no arbitrary uncurated colors or legacy raw utilities).
Preserve all existing data-testid and accessibility aria attributes.
Production build (npm run build) must exit 0.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: In CopilotHeroHud.jsx, eliminate premature greeting truncation so that 'Good morning, <FirstName>! 👋' renders in full without getting clipped into an ellipsis across all viewports (min-width >= 320px up to 1920px).
AC2: In CopilotHeroHud.jsx, relieve quote & button group crowding by adjusting layout flow and responsive breakpoint so the quote never squeezes the greeting text.

AC3: In CubaMetricCardRow.jsx, update the Avg. ATS Score card to display a bold, prominent score value alongside the SVG donut gauge, matching the visual typographic hierarchy of Total Resumes (5), Job Applications (2), and Interview Coach (Ready).
AC4: Apply polished Cuba Modern Executive glassmorphism and micro-interactions across both the hero card and the 4 metric cards (elevation, smooth transitions, authentic Cuba tokens).
AC5: Invariants hold: zero diff in src/cv-templates/, zero hardcoded mock telemetry, all regression test suites pass, and npm run build succeeds cleanly.
